recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The current notes and existing example satisfy the example/guidance request, while the focused source change resolves the remaining FHIR-38034 mismatch without disturbing later R6 derivation or parameter/profile alignment decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-38034 is Published/Persuasive for R5. It requested additional guidance for defining and using derived OperationDefinitions, moving the OperationDefinition.base comment into a separate notes section, explaining that a derived operation declares its base, may keep or change its code, and must respect existing parameter constraints, plus an example derived OperationDefinition.

That commit did not update OperationDefinition.base, so the element comment still retained the old moved guidance about what a constrained profile can do.
additional_context: OperationDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-48481 added detailed SHOULD-level derivation rules and version-specific canonical-reference guidance, and FHIR-52921 added complementary parameter/profile alignment guidance. Those later decisions do not supersede FHIR-38034; they constrain the reconciliation to removing only the stale moved base comment while preserving the newer derivation guidance. FHIR-I minutes for 2022-11-21 record the FHIR-38034 Persuasive vote, and direct Zulip search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml so OperationDefinition.base now retains only version-specific canonical-reference advice, removing the stale 'A constrained profile can...' guidance that belongs in the notes section. Changed source/operationdefinition/operationdefinition-notes.xml so the introductory sentence directly says that a derived OperationDefinition declares a base.
